reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. Every published braces is affected (range <=3.0.3, latest 3.0.3) and only reaches the build through tailwindcss 3 (chokidar, fast-glob, micromatch); npm audit --omit=dev is clean in both trees, so nothing vulnerable ships. npm's only fix is the tailwindcss 4 major. Remove this entry as soon as a fixed braces (or a micromatch/chokidar that drops it) is published.
